info.title: Cal ID API
info.description:
API documentation for external developers integrating with Cal ID. This documentation is auto-generated from our OpenAPI specification and includes details on all available endpoints, request/response schemas, and authentication methods.

Authentication is required for all endpoints and can be done using API key generated from the Cal ID dashboard under the `settings/developer/api-keys` page. Use the Authorization header with the Bearer scheme to authenticate your requests.

Example:
- API Key: `Authorization: Bearer calid_xxxxx`

Note: To manage Team's resources use the Team's owner/admin API key

bearerAuth.description:
Use the Authorization header with Bearer scheme.

Examples:
- API Key: Authorization: Bearer calid_xxxxx

get.description: Get available slots for an event type or users

parameters.name: eventTypeId
parameters.description: Event type ID to fetch availability for. Required unless `eventTypeSlug` includes owner context (`<username>/<slug>` or `team/<teamSlug>/<slug>`) or is paired with `usernameList`.

parameters.name: eventTypeSlug
parameters.description: Event type slug used for slug-based slot lookup. Supports values like `discovery-call-30` or `<username>/<slug>` and `team/<teamSlug>/<slug>`.

parameters.name: usernameList
parameters.description: One or more usernames for slug-based lookup. A single username value is also accepted and normalized to an array.

parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.description: IANA timezone used to return slots.

parameters.name: bookingUidToReschedule
parameters.description: Booking UID being rescheduled, used to include the original booking slot in availability.

parameters.name: isTeamEvent
parameters.description: Whether lookup should be treated as a team event flow.

time.description: Slot start time in ISO-8601 format.

start.description: Slot start time in ISO-8601 format (range mode).

end.description: Slot end time in ISO-8601 format (range mode).

attendees.description: Number of attendees currently assigned to the slot.

bookingUid.description: Booking UID occupying this slot when present.

away.description: Indicates the slot is blocked because of out-of-office settings.

fromUser.description: User currently marked out-of-office for this slot date.

toUser.description: Delegated teammate covering availability for this slot date.

eventTypeId.description: Event type identifier for the slot reservation.
